story.title: UpGrad to Acquire Unacademy for Rs 2,055 Crore — 90% Below Peak Valuation in India's Edtech Reckoning
story.summary: Ronnie Screwvala's UpGrad is set to acquire Unacademy for approximately Rs 2,055 crore — a valuation nearly 90% below Unacademy's peak of over Rs 20,000 crore — marking one of the starkest corrections in India's edtech sector since its pandemic-era peak. The deal, which follows months of on-again, off-again negotiations, is being financed partly through an internal fundraising round of approximately Rs 375 crore from existing backers including Temasek, a common investor in both companies. The consolidation reflects broader pressure on India's online learning platforms as post-COVID enrolment normalised and profitability proved elusive. The combined entity would position UpGrad as India's dominant working-professional upskilling platform.
